summary: Iteration 4 focused on the new image-management feature set: admin bearer auth, Emergent object-storage upload, /api/files serving, admin product CRUD, DB-before-seed ordering, and the /admin React panel. Backend: 71 pytest cases across 3 files (backend_test.py, test_new_features.py, new test_admin_images.py) -> 70 passed, 1 failed (minor edge case). Frontend: full /admin flow exercised end-to-end with Playwright (login gate, invalid token, upload roundtrip, create, storefront visibility, product detail, delete) - all passed. All products created during testing were deleted.

minor.issue: Updating a SOFT-DELETED product returns 200 instead of 404. The Mongo filter is {'id': product_id} without 'is_deleted': {'$ne': True}, so a deleted product can still be mutated (and if a future PATCH ever sets is_deleted it would resurrect). Same missing guard exists in DELETE (deleting an already-deleted product returns 200).
Dead code: `base = os.environ.get('PUBLIC_FILES_BASE', '')` is computed and never used.
Deleting a product does not soft-delete / remove the associated uploaded file in db.files or object storage -> orphaned objects accumulate. No endpoint exists to delete a file.

issues: React console error on every render: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>. This will cause a hydration error.' Triggered by dynamic option labels in Category.jsx line ~100 being wrapped by the preview instrumentation. Cosmetic/console-only but pollutes the console and can break hydration.
Delete uses the native window.confirm() browser dialog instead of a styled AlertDialog, inconsistent with the rest of the design system.

Several seeded Unsplash images are not relevant to the product name (e.g. na3 'Green Floral Printed A-Line Kurta' renders a saree portrait; na5 renders an unrelated portrait). Pre-existing content issue, not a regression.

action_items: Add is_deleted guard to admin PATCH/DELETE product Mongo filters so soft-deleted products return 404.

Wrap put_object()/get_object() (blocking `requests` calls) in fastapi.concurrency.run_in_threadpool or switch to httpx.AsyncClient — today every /api/files/{id} image request and every 8 MB upload blocks the FastAPI event loop; the whole storefront proxies its admin images through this route.
Remove unused PUBLIC_FILES_BASE line in admin_upload.
Populate /app/memory/test_credentials.md with the admin token (currently the file is an empty template).
Optional: clean up the leftover demo product 'Test Ruby Kurti' (id a77401c2-ee64-4dff-8c51-3dfc92942b74) that is currently live and first on the home page / Kurtis category.
Optional: delete or soft-delete the associated file record when a product is deleted.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py put_object/get_object/init_storage use the synchronous `requests` library and are called directly from async route handlers (admin_upload, get_file) — this blocks the event loop for the full duration of the storage round-trip. Highest-impact fix this iteration.
admin PATCH/DELETE filters ignore is_deleted, so soft-deleted docs remain writable.
server.py is 654 lines and mixes seed data, storage client, admin CRUD and checkout — consider splitting into routers/ (products, admin, checkout) and data/seed.py before it exceeds 700 lines.
compute_totals correctly merges DB products now; verified via COD checkout with a DB-created product (subtotal/shipping/total all correct).
Admin token is stored in localStorage as plain text and is a single shared static secret — acceptable for this MVP but should be called out to the user.

rca_of_the_issue: Only failing test: test_patch_deleted_product_should_404. Root cause — admin_update_product queries db.products.update_one({'id': product_id}) with no is_deleted filter, so a soft-deleted document still matches (matched_count=1) and the endpoint returns 200 with the updated doc. Reproduce: POST /api/admin/products -> DELETE it -> PATCH it with {'price':900}; expect 404, get 200. Fix: add "is_deleted": {"$ne": True} to the filter in both admin_update_product and admin_delete_product.
